resources.string: Shown while Scribe has the microphone open.
Your voice is being transcribed on this phone.
Shown while the optional floating button is on screen.
Tap the bubble to dictate. The keyboard is the reliable option.

Lets Scribe show a dictation button when you tap a text box, and type what you say into it. Scribe checks whether the focused view accepts text, and reads the field\'s contents only at the moment it inserts a transcript, so it can place your words at the cursor without deleting what is already there. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
